name: Orchard Pocket Park

layers.essential_history: [[c:The orchard is a community pocket park, and it holds an apple day every October. The council lists it as Old Orchard, in Eaglethorpe next to the bypass.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The board says this was once part of an orchard in the grounds of the Mill House, until the land for the A605 bypass was bought in 1985. The pocket park was set up in 1997 to protect a rare orchard and grow English apple varieties that are facing extinction. The board says Warmington was the first village to set up two pocket parks at once, and the first to have an orchard. The row of cherry plums along the southern edge was planted as a windbreak.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: apples keep through the winter, and so does grain, if someone guards it properly.]]
